2121395815981924418.en_summary: Cerebras does not use HBM, but by their own calculations running Kimi K3 requires 59 wafers. Simply saying they do not need HBM is marketing wordplay. Their role is replacing GPUs in certain inference workloads or complementing AMD, with AMD GPUs handling prefill and long context while Cerebras handles decode. They are moving toward 3D stacked DRAM and will eventually compete for memory supply. This approach could make sense given current supply chain constraints, but technical limitations of wafer-scale chips must be overcome and efficiency proven as models and systems grow larger.
2121395815981924418.zh_summary: Cerebras不使用HBM，但據其自身計算，運行Kimi K3需要59片晶圓。簡單聲稱不需要HBM只是行銷話術。目前其角色是在某些推理工作負載中取代GPU，或與AMD互補，AMD GPU處理預填充與長上下文，而Cerebras處理解碼以快速生成回應。他們正朝向3D堆疊DRAM發展，最終也需競爭記憶體供應。在目前供應鏈限制下此方法或有意義，但必須克服晶圓級晶片的技術限制，並在模型與系統變大時證明能持續有效運作。

2121393974598586446.en_summary: A software update crashed the air traffic control communications network run by $LHX L3Harris, causing the nationwide ground stop.
2121393974598586446.zh_summary: 一次軟體更新導致由$LHX L3Harris運行的空中交通管制通訊網路崩潰，造成全國範圍地面停飛。

2121393048819212597.en_summary: Two major $NVDA shareholders, Brad Gerstner of Altimeter Capital and Gavin Baker of Atreides Management, sent a joint letter to the board asking it to pursue a slow, measured process on future leadership that leaves all options open including the potential return of Jensen Huang. They warn against rushing a replacement that undermines shareholder interests, noting the company will be capably led interim by Colette Kress. A petition site launched demanding reinstatement pending independent investigation. Elon Musk joined calls for Huang's reinstatement. The board said it has not formally engaged any candidates and has not yet selected a search firm.
2121393048819212597.zh_summary: 兩大$NVDA股東Altimeter Capital的Brad Gerstner與Atreides Management的Gavin Baker致函董事會，要求對未來領導層採取緩慢審慎程序，保留所有選項包括Jensen Huang潛在回歸。他們警告勿倉促替換以免損害股東利益，並指出公司過渡期將由Colette Kress妥善領導。已有請願網站要求在獨立調查完成前復職。Elon Musk也加入要求Huang復職的呼籲。董事會表示尚未正式接觸任何候選人，也未選定搜尋公司。

2121392922784325725.en_summary: $NVDA ended the week in a 33% drawdown off its early-October record high, the worst of the Mag 7.
2121392922784325725.zh_summary: $NVDA本週結束時從十月初紀錄高點回撤33%，是Mag 7中表現最差的。

2121392673613545861.en_summary: $H Hyatt CEO says early ChatGPT travel users are younger and spend more, but rarely complete bookings. Through direct representation in ChatGPT platform apps they have better handle on users who are younger and spending a lot more on travel, but booking activity that concludes in that environment is still very low.
2121392673613545861.zh_summary: $H Hyatt CEO表示，早期ChatGPT旅遊使用者較年輕且花費更多，但很少完成預訂。透過ChatGPT平台應用程式的直接呈現，他們對這些使用者有更好掌握，他們更年輕且在旅遊上花費更多，但在該環境中實際完成預訂的活動仍然非常低。
